# Installation

## What you need

- Python 3.12+
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)

## Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/benedekaibas/pytifex
cd pytifex

export COHERE_API_KEY=your_cohere_api_key   # or set up another provider, see below

# optional, only raises GitHub rate limits
export GITHUB_TOKEN=ghp_your_github_token

uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025
```

`--extra dev` is what actually installs mypy, pyrefly, zuban, and ty — they're declared as an optional dependency group in `pyproject.toml`, not a base dependency. Leave it off and `uv run pytifex` only installs pytifex's own two dependencies; the checkers won't exist on `PATH` and every checker call fails.

## Environment variables

| Variable | When it's needed | What it's for |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | Using `--openai-base-url` against an authenticated server | API key for OpenAI, or whatever token your local/lab server expects |
| `COHERE_API_KEY` | Using a `command-*` model | Cohere API key (`CO_API_KEY` also works) |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Optional | Raises the GitHub API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour |

You need exactly one provider key, unless you're pointing at a local server with no auth — then you need none.

## Setting up each provider

### OpenAI-compatible (real OpenAI, or any local/lab server)

```bash
# real OpenAI
export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model gpt-4o --openai-base-url https://api.openai.com/v1

# a local server, no key needed unless it requires one
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model qwen3-6b --openai-base-url http://localhost:8080/v1
```

`--openai-base-url` forces this provider regardless of the model name — the model name just has to match what the server itself calls it.

### Cohere

```bash
export COHERE_API_KEY=your_key
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025
```

## One current gap

If you omit both `--model` and `--openai-base-url`, the CLI falls back to Gemini — that's a hard-coded default in `main.py`/`agent.py` left over from an earlier version. It's planned to come out. Until it does, always pass a provider flag explicitly rather than leaving `--model` at its default.
